summary: 43 units (87-129) reviewed. 2 errors, 33 minor. Errors: u102 false lost-visarga flag (regular sandhi kūrcā+h); u111 Hindi bare जंघा means thigh. Minor: unhedged probable identifications (antarādhi, jatru, trika in Hindi), sakthi -> lower limb, added Hindi words (जैसी, स्थित, संख्या, हड्डियाँ, नामक प्रजनन-द्रव), gram gender on unstated nouns, missing own flag for jivhā at u104. Open: u101 -jāni vs -jālāni, u119/u120 akṣaka vs jatru both collarbone, u122 madhya, u91 reading. No identification judged clearly wrong; counts kept as printed (sums 16, 14, 360=140+120+100, 35 per limb check out).
glossary_suggestions: jaṅghā in Hindi = जङ्घा यानी घुटने से नीचे का भाग (bare जंघा means thigh).
Regular sandhi kūrcāḥ + h- -> kūrcā h-: no lost-visarga flag (before any voiced consonant incl. h).
akṣaka (probably collar-bone) and jatru (region of collarbone/neck-shoulder junction): keep apart; OPEN how to render jatru.
trika Hindi = त्रिक यानी सम्भवतः त्रिकास्थि वाला क्षेत्र; antarādhi = probably trunk, hedged in both languages.
kaṇḍarā counts: 16 = 8 (hands/feet two each) + 4 + 4 (neck, back) only if four each; leg bone count 35 per limb = 5 nails+15+5 rods+1+2+2+2+1+1+1 supports conjectural pārṣṇi in u111.
